subject: RE: FW: AMSTERDAM SCHIPHOL - HKG / 128 PCS 165 KGS
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option to SGN (Ho Chi Minh City, VN)? The goods will be ready for pickup from our warehouse on 2026-11-30. Please arrange the truck from our warehouse to the departure airport and include this in your all-in price in EUR.

The shipment consists of 11 pieces of precision instruments, with a gross weight of 572 kg and a total volume of 2.29 cbm.

Thank you in advance.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
